_comment: Generated by plugins/zelda_bmg/stage_data.py from res/Stage. msg_group = bmgres<N>.arc the stage loads (scopes local flow IDs). rooms.*.actors/objects = placement rosters (who is physically where). rooms.*.events = event_list.dat cast (staff) per scripted scene. flow_owner = dialogue flow node -> NPC placement name, read from ACTR angle.x (fopAcM_prmBase_class.angle @0x18), which is what daNpc*::getFlowNodeNo() returns. Scoped by the stage's msg_group.
